title: AI Line Art Generator
summary: Make line art with AI: clean contour drawings, one-line portraits, coloring pages and inked characters. Describe it, pick a line style, and Flick draws it.
body_markdown:
### How do I make line art with AI?


Describe the subject, then the line weight and what to leave out, such as clean black line art of a café with one uniform line weight and no shading, then pick a line art style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the drawing into a clip.


### Can AI turn a photo into line art?


Yes. Add the photo as a reference image and ask for clean black line art of it with no shading or fills, keeping the same pose and framing; the result traces the photo's main contours.


### Can I make coloring pages with AI line art?


Yes. Ask for coloring book line art with thick, consistent outlines, closed shapes and pure white inside every shape, then print it; leaving out grey and hatching keeps every area easy to colour.


### Can I make a single continuous line drawing?


Yes. Ask for a single continuous line drawing in one unbroken line that never lifts, with a thin, even stroke and a plain background; simple subjects such as a face in profile or a hand work best.


### Is the line art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every week with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
